entities.summary: Keiji Fukuda  is a Japanese-American physician and epidemiologist, specializing in influenza epidemiology. He was an Assistant Director-General of the World Health Organization (WHO) from 2009 to 2016, and the Director of the School of Public Health at the University of Hong Kong (HKU) between 2017 and 2021.
